data.title: 久岛鸥 · 海蚀洞窟的篝火夜话
data.description: 避风海蚀洞窟内，潮声回荡。中央生起一堆噼啪作响的篝火，鸥裹着薄毯盘腿坐在干草铺上，手握小树枝拨动火星，兴致勃勃地讲述古老航海传说。
data.location: sheltered sea cave cavern with opening framing a moonlit night ocean tide
data.action: sitting cross-legged by a crackling campfire, gesturing with a small stick, golden eyes lit up by firelight as she narrates tales
data.lighting: 篝火跳跃火光与洞口清冷月华
data.promptProse: Wrapped in a thin blanket, Kamome sits cross-legged on dry straw inside the sheltered sea cave and stirs the campfire with a small branch as she tells a pirate story. Firelight flickers across the rough cave walls, and cool moonlight reaches the tide visible through the cave mouth.
data.animaCaption: Wrapped in a blanket, she stirs the campfire with a small branch while the cave mouth frames the moonlit sea.
